scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, the thesis and the access window: at the top, a rolled document with a small rising bar chart drawn on it, labelled THESIS: 2× VOLUME. Below it, a short horizontal timeline with two milestones joined by an arrow pointing right: a pen signing a blank sheet with only a squiggle signature and no words on it, labelled SIGNING, then a handshake over a small briefcase labelled CLOSING. A large magnifying glass hovers over the thesis document, pointing toward the middle zone.

MIDDLE ZONE, the finding and its options: a tall navy-outlined record card at the top labelled FINDING D-3. On the card, a single person figure seated at a laptop, with a small hand-entering-settings icon, labelled ONE SPECIALIST, and beside it a stopwatch with a plain blank face (no digits on the dial), labelled 80 HOURS underneath. Below the card, three option cards stacked vertically, each with one icon: two person figures on the card labelled HIRE TWO €300K A YEAR; a single gear with a test flask on the card labelled PILOT €180K, which carries a large ochre check mark; the stamp labelled APPROVED sits beside the price, never overlapping it; a target with a smaller inner ring on the card labelled NARROW TARGET; inside that same card, below its label, two short horizontal bars side by side, a long bar labelled 2× and a visibly shorter bar labelled 1.5×, with a small arrow pointing from the long bar to the short bar, showing the target was lowered. No other arrows or curves next to the option cards.

RIGHT ZONE, the review: at the top, a woman figure holding a clipboard, labelled PRIYA ACCOUNTABLE. Below her, a horizontal timeline with two milestones joined by a line with an arrow pointing right: a magnifying glass over a small group of customer figures labelled DAY 90: MEASURE; a meeting table labelled DAY 100: BOARD DECIDES. From the meeting table, three branches fan out downward to three signposts, top to bottom: a plain teal arrow-shaped signpost with no writing on it, labelled BELOW 60: NEXT STAGE; a plain signboard showing only a wrench, labelled 60–70: NEXT FIX; an ochre triangle caution sign with only an exclamation mark, labelled ABOVE 70: REOPEN HIRING.

Signs, dials, documents and screens carry no writing. TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: THESIS: 2× VOLUME, SIGNING, CLOSING, FINDING D-3, ONE SPECIALIST, 80 HOURS, HIRE TWO €300K A YEAR, PILOT €180K, APPROVED, NARROW TARGET, 2×, 1.5×, PRIYA ACCOUNTABLE, DAY 90: MEASURE, DAY 100: BOARD DECIDES, BELOW 60: NEXT STAGE, 60–70: NEXT FIX, ABOVE 70: REOPEN HIRING. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A thesis of doubled onboarding volume is examined between signing and closing; finding D-3 shows one specialist and 80 hours per setup; of three options the €180,000 pilot is approved, hiring two for €300,000 a year and narrowing the target are not, and the growth assumption falls from 2× to 1.5×; Priya is accountable, measures at day 90, and at day 100 the board chooses the next stage below 60 hours, the next fix at 60 to 70, or reopens hiring above 70.
caption: From the thesis to finding D-3, the option that was funded, and the day-100 rule that decides what comes next.
